summary: Emergent BioSolutions filed an 8-K reporting a $52.7M contract modification (Option Year 7) from ASPR for ACAM2000 vaccine supply. The modification exercises an option under a 10-year existing contract for vaccine doses, ancillaries, and diluent delivered by December 2026. No board recommendation or advisor is named. This is a routine government contract modification, not a special situation. No deal terms, structural changes, or strategic events apply. The filing is purely operational disclosure.
